statement.p: A truck is traveling due north at 55 km/hr approaching a crossroad. On a perpendicular road a police car is traveling west toward the intersection at 75 km/hr. Both vehicles will reach the crossroad in exactly one hour. Find the vector currently representing the displacement of the truck with respect to the police car.

static.solution: P and the crossroads is at C. If \vec d is the vector representing the line of sight of the truck with respect to the police car. \vec d = -75\,\mathit{\vec i}-55\,\mathit{\vec j}.
